personality-match.title: Which K-pop Idol Matches Your Personality?
personality-match.cardSummary: Nine questions that match you with a fictional stage persona.
personality-match.summary: Answer nine questions about how you move through a room. Every persona here is fictional: a role written for Kaleid, not a real idol.
personality-match.rules: Each answer gives 2 points to one fictional persona. The persona with the most points wins. If two or more share the highest total, the winner is the earliest persona in the list below.

pace.prompt: When a song starts, what do you do first?

options.a: Step into the light and take the first line.
options.b: Find the sharpest word and say it clean.
options.c: Listen for the harmony and hold it steady.
options.d: Watch the room and write down what it misses.

mistake.prompt: You miss a cue in front of people. You...

options.a: Keep going and make the next moment louder.
options.b: Name it in one sentence and move on.
options.c: Stay on your part and bring the group back in.
options.d: Note why it happened before you speak.

options.b: The line that has to land.

options.a: A run-through until it feels obvious.
options.d: A walk with no playlist, then a page of lines.

opinion.prompt: Someone asks what you think. You...

options.b: Say the exact thing, even if it is small.
options.c: Ask what the group needs before you answer.
options.d: Describe what you noticed, then the point.

options.a: Short, bright, and in front of a mirror.
options.b: Focused on the words until they are clean.
options.c: Slow enough that the harmony locks.
options.d: Quiet enough that you can hear the missing line.

options.c: The song sat better with you in it.
options.d: You caught what we did not say.

options.a: Take the next cue before anyone assigns it.
options.b: Cut the sentence down and deliver it.
options.c: Keep the tempo for the people beside you.
options.d: Get quieter and look for the true line.

note.prompt: The note you trust most is...

options.b: The one with no extra words.
options.c: The one that supports the lead.

lina-voss.name: Lina Voss
lina-voss.explanation: You match Lina, a fictional center vocal. You take the visible line and trust the room to follow.

mira-noh.name: Mira Noh
mira-noh.explanation: You match Mira, a fictional lead rap. You cut to the exact word and leave the extra ones out.

theo-park.name: Theo Park
theo-park.explanation: You match Theo, a fictional sub vocal. You steady the song for everyone else in it.

noa-bel.name: Noa Bel
noa-bel.explanation: You match Noa, a fictional lyricist. You notice the missing line and write it down.

ideal-match.title: Which K-pop Idol Is Your Ideal Match?
ideal-match.cardSummary: Nine questions that name the fictional persona you keep choosing.
ideal-match.summary: Answer nine questions about the person you want beside you. The match is a fictional stage persona, not a claim about a real idol.
ideal-match.rules: Each answer gives 2 points to one fictional persona. The persona with the most points wins. If two or more share the highest total, the winner is the earliest persona in the list below.

beside.prompt: On stage, you want someone who...

options.a: Stands calm and makes the picture clear.
options.b: Moves first and pulls the energy up.
options.c: Builds the arrangement before the lights rise.
options.d: Commits to the performance with nothing held back.

after.prompt: After the show, you want them to...

options.a: Sit with you until the room goes quiet.
options.b: Still be buzzing, ready for one more song.
options.c: Talk through what worked and what to fix.
options.d: Replay the feeling, not the checklist.

quality.prompt: The quality you keep looking for is...

options.b: Turn the change into a new move.
options.c: Rebuild the set so it still holds.
options.d: Say yes and figure the show out live.

options.a: The frame gets clearer when they enter.
options.b: The rhythm changes when they move.
options.c: The song sounds finished near them.
options.d: The performance gets braver near them.

message.prompt: A message from them sounds like...

options.a: I am here. Take your time.
options.d: Do it bigger. I will match you.

options.a: A clean room and a long window.
options.b: A class, a street, a new step.
options.d: A stage they were not booked to use.

options.c: Ends with a plan you can both play.
options.d: Gets honest fast, then gets warm again.

choosing.prompt: The choice you repeat is someone who...

sora-ell.name: Sora Ell
sora-ell.explanation: Your ideal match is Sora, a fictional visual. You keep choosing composure and a clear frame.

jae-rim.name: Jae Rim
jae-rim.explanation: Your ideal match is Jae, a fictional main dancer. You keep choosing motion and a brighter tempo.

hana-sol.name: Hana Sol
hana-sol.explanation: Your ideal match is Hana, a fictional producer. You keep choosing craft and a song that holds together.

ryn-cho.name: Ryn Cho
ryn-cho.explanation: Your ideal match is Ryn, a fictional performer. You keep choosing nerve and a risk you can share.
